provenance.group_definition: Exact known category token after HTML unescape; no score-based labels or anchor selection.
provenance.pair_sampling: At most 300 unique anchors per category, one distinct-title same-category partner and one uniformly chosen other category partner per anchor.
provenance.brand_control_sampling: Up to 2000 distinct-title, nonempty-brand unordered pairs per observed category/brand cell; not a causal experiment.
provenance.distance_definition: cosine = x dot y / (norm(x)*norm(y)); raw_l2 = norm(x-y). Source embeddings are unchanged.
limitations: Weak category labels cover 6.99% of the catalog and include some mislabeled accessories.
Two-dimensional PCA is a projection, not the original 2560-dimensional distance.
No human relevance judgments or downstream recommendation accuracy are measured.
